title: Buon Ma Thuot in a day
summary: The prison on Tan Thuat in the morning, Dray Nur south on the Serepok, then Khải Đoan and bún đỏ back in town.

stops.name: Buon Ma Thuot Prison
stops.note: The yellow compound at 18 Tan Thuat in the morning.

approach.note: A short taxi from the center to 18 Tan Thuat.

stops.name: Dray Nur Waterfall
stops.note: A curtain about 250 m wide on the Serepok, about 25 km or about 30 km south.

stops.name: Khai Doan Pagoda
stops.note: The courtyard, the wooden hall, and the white pavilion take 30 to 45 minutes.

approach.note: Taxi from the center to Phan Boi Chau.

stops.name: Bun do
stops.note: The red noodles on Le Hong Phong from about 15:00 or 16:00.

approach.note: Walk or a short taxi to Le Hong Phong.

seoTitle: Buon Ma Thuot in a day
seoDescription: One day in Buon Ma Thuot: the prison on Tan Thuat, Dray Nur on the Serepok, Khải Đoan, and bún đỏ on Le Hong Phong.
